_comment: Asian board for the 2026-09-06 slate (Taipei 09-07). Seventh slate of the prospective test, and all fifteen games are legible with first-half totals. Eleven games show the board's own moneyline column, and all eleven agree with the US market -- that column has still never disagreed. Two games are quoted at a 0 handicap (Braves at Phillies, Rays at Rangers), where laying and receiving are the same wager and the favourite label carries no meaning; both are also near coin flips in the US market, at 0.5000. Two games have no moneyline column and my row reading agrees with the market anyway: Blue Jays at Royals (Toronto, 0.4752 home, none of fifteen books above even) and Yankees at Padres (New York, 0.4892 home, none above). One conflict, and it is the same game as yesterday: Diamondbacks at Astros. I again read the full-game handicap on Arizona's row, and the market again has Houston, at 0.5045 with twelve of fifteen books above even money and none below. This board carries an extra tell -- its own first-half handicap for that game sits on Houston's row while the full-game handicap sits on Arizona's, which is internally inconsistent, since the two halves of one game do not have opposite favourites. Under the rule adopted 09-05 the moneyline decides: Houston is the favourite, my reading is recorded as the alternative and still priced both ways. Handicaps flat at 0.950, totals flat at 0.940, no split prices anywhere on this board.
